thesis_statement: Kalman Filter State Estimation - The optimal recursive algorithm to estimate the true state of a linear dynamic system from a series of incomplete and noisy measurements
parent_thesis: Peano axioms

thesis_statement: PID Feedback Loop Control - A continuous feedback loop that regulates a system by calculating proportional, integral, and derivative corrections based on error
parent_thesis: First law of thermodynamics energy conservation
context_description: The dominant industrial closed-loop control system, adjusting processes through current error, past accumulated error, and error velocity.

thesis_statement: Nyquist Stability Criterion - The closed-loop stability of a feedback system is determined by the frequency response of its open-loop transfer function
parent_thesis: Peano axioms
context_description: A complex-analytic mapping technique evaluating stability by counting open-loop pole encirclements on the Nyquist plot.

thesis_statement: Denavit-Hartenberg Kinematics - A standard coordinate representation for calculating the spatial position of robotic linkages
parent_thesis: Peano axioms
context_description: A matrix factorization convention assigning coordinate frames to joints to solve forward and inverse robotic kinematics.

thesis_statement: Shannon's Information Capacity in Control - The feedback capacity limit of a control system is bounded by the communication rate of the feedback channel
parent_thesis: Shannon-Hartley Theorem (Channel Capacity)
context_description: Links control theory to information theory, showing that unstable processes cannot be stabilized if the feedback channel capacity is too low.
